description: The agent's a-priori capability map for developing its EAR + SPEECH engine: the speech_world Microtheory it operates in, the per-faculty Operators (each applies_in speech_world, runner = the mechanical executor it dispatches to), and the CapabilityAxis nodes (the gaps the understand-drive's frontier ranks). investigated_by names which faculty addresses which axis (the selectional wiring, read by the bind_investigation_faculty JOIN). No agent decision here — this is the agent's self-model of what it should be able to do, the same kind of domain capability data a chess/doom seed carries.

microtheory.name: speech_capability
microtheory.description: the agent's ear+speech capability frontier: recognise words (analysis-by-synthesis vs piper, ground-truth whisper) and segment continuous speech (corpus -> utterances -> signs).

attrs.name: abs_recogniser
attrs.comment: analysis-by-synthesis word recognition: piper voices a word -> the agent's own ear -> WordHat recognise -> whisper ground-truth.

attrs.name: continuous_segmenter
attrs.comment: continuous-speech segmentation: corpus clip -> ingest_speech -> utterances/AcousticSigns -> purity vs whisper labels.
